strategy.plain_english: Buys Yes/No when the 1-minute trend is clean, BTC is at least $40 from the strike, the ask is 35–75¢, and 2–15 minutes remain in the window. Requires the 50-period EMA to agree. Requires the 5-minute trend to agree. Also skips choppy tapes (chop ratio above 0.80). Holds every ticket to official Kalshi settlement (no early exits).
